caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a metallic watering can with an angular, faceted body and a long, straight spout projecting from the left side. The can is rendered in shades of reddish-brown and copper, with visible patches of greenish oxidation and highlights that suggest a reflective, metallic surface. The handle is attached vertically to the right side of the can and extends upward in a flat arc. The overall composition centers the watering can against a plain, untextured beige background, with no additional objects or patterns present. The can is shown in a three-quarter perspective, revealing the angled sides, the depth of the body, the spout, and the handle.
title: Syrup Cruet
